scripts.typecheck: cargo check --locked -p inframeld-cli -p inframeld-cli-xtask --all-targets --all-features && RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --locked -p inframeld-cli -p inframeld-cli-xtask --no-deps
scripts.audit: cargo deny --manifest-path Cargo.toml --locked check && cargo deny --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml --locked check
